Resumen:
Webpay Plus (Transbank) resumed processing transactions at 23:37 CLT. New payments are being completed through this payment method again. We are keeping this incident open while we monitor the stability of the service. Transaction volumes and completion rates have not yet returned to their usual levels. Transactions that were initiated during the outage and did not receive a final result remain unresolved. Their status is being reviewed with Transbank.

Investigating: We are currently experiencing an outage affecting payment processing through Webpay Plus (Transbank). Transactions are not being completed through this payment method. The issue originates in the Transbank service and not in our platform. Their API is not responding to our requests, which prevents both the initiation of new payments and the retrieval of results for payments already started by the payer. Timeline so far: 20:00 CLT Intermittent connection failures begin. 22:07 CLT Service degradation becomes total. No transaction has been completed through this payment method since this time. Transactions initiated during this period may remain unresolved. For a portion of them, the payer reached the Webpay payment form and the final outcome has not been returned to us. All of our other payment methods for Chile continue to operate normally. This incident is limited to Webpay Plus. We have escalated the incident to Transbank with critical priority and are monitoring the service continuously. We do not yet have an estimated time to resolution from Transbank.
